listing.name: Star Wars Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy (single player and multiplayer) (OpenJK / OpenJO)
listing.summary: Prepare Star Wars Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy (single player and multiplayer) through its upstream player using your own original files. Setup, profiles and updates stay upstream-owned.
listing.original_game_title: Star Wars Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy (single player and multiplayer)

steps.title: Use the matching original game
steps.instruction: Use your own complete Jedi Academy PC GameData/base resources. Jedi Outcast and OpenJKDF2 are different games. Keep the original installation unchanged and prepare a separate complete working GameData copy; the reviewed README does not pin a retail patch/revision.

steps.title: Prepare upstream and select the player
steps.instruction: Extract the complete official OpenJK-windows-x86_64.zip into the prepared GameData folder. Select openjk_sp.x86_64.exe for single player or openjk.x86_64.exe for multiplayer, with GameData as working directory. A registration selects one player/mode; openjkded.x86_64.exe is a dedicated server, not the player. Retain all package libraries/resources.

steps.title: Preserve the actual player data
steps.instruction: Normal Windows builds use Documents/My Games/OpenJK. BUILD_PORTABLE and explicit home-path settings can change this. Preserve the actual base/mod profiles, saves, configuration, original-data copy and creating runtime; upstream compatibility statements are not Portcove observations.

steps.title: Keep external ownership and deliberate Play
steps.instruction: Finish upstream preparation before registration. Register the real player with its matching working directory and separate literal argument lines. Play is a separate explicit action. You and upstream own this runtime, original files, saves and configuration. Registration-only removal preserves these external files; managed Update, Backup, Rollback, migration and deletion are unavailable for them. Preserve the working runtime and every actual data/profile location with the game closed before upstream replacement. Other platforms require their own upstream flow.
